notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Shiprock as Arizona with Oct. 2-5 dates. Current official Northern Navajo Fair information confirms Shiprock, New Mexico, with 2026 dates Oct. 1-4. Territory hold — New Mexico is not currently being actively pursued; preserve this as historical/contact research only and do not create a normal outreach task. Source: handwritten call notes, page 89; official Northern Navajo Fair website.
